unitTitle: An Early Bird or a Night Owl?
scanNote: 16-mashqda jadvalning bir necha katagi AUDIO orqali to'ldiriladi (Meri va Royning tug'ilgan yili, vaqti va kun qismi). Audio yo'q — shu sababli bu mashqda TO'LIQ ma'lum bo'lgan Tom uchun gap tuziladi, Meri va Roy uchun esa faqat MA'LUM qismlar bilan qolip mashq qilinadi. Noma'lum katakchalar aniq belgilangan.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example. Then, write a short paragraph about your partner.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling. So'ng sherigingiz haqida qisqa xatboshi yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL QOLIPI:
  How often do you + fe'l + ... ?

JAVOB VARIANTLARI (kitobdagi ro'yxat):
  never                          — hech qachon
  every day / month / evening    — har kuni / oy / kechqurun
  every two / three days         — ikki / uch kunda bir
  every Sunday                   — har yakshanba
  sometimes                      — ba'zan
  once / twice a week / month    — haftada/oyda bir/ikki marta

DIQQAT — SON IFODALARI:
  once  = bir marta ('one time' EMAS)
  twice = ikki marta ('two times' EMAS)
  three times = uch marta (3 dan boshlab 'times')

NAMUNA:
  SA: How often do you go to the swimming-pool?
  SB: Twice a week.
  SA: How often do you go to the theatre?
  SB: Never...

SO'NG XATBOSHI yoziladi (3-shaxsda!):
  'Tony GOES to the swimming-pool twice a week,
   but he NEVER GOES to the theatre.'

items.question: How often do you go to the swimming-pool?
How often do you go to the theatre?
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. 'never' — qisqa javob sifatida yolg'iz ishlatilishi mumkin.

items.question: How often do you clean your room?
How often do you go fishing?
How often do you go out with your family?
items.whyUz: 'go out' = ko'chaga chiqmoq, dam olishga chiqmoq.

items.question: How often do you play computer games?
How often do you watch TV?
How often do you meet your friends?
How often do you go shopping?
items.whyUz: 'every two days' = ikki kunda bir marta.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, write a short paragraph about your partner.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng sherigingiz haqida qisqa xatboshi yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
XATBOSHIDA 3-SHAXS ishlatiladi — demak fe'l -s OLADI:
  I go → he GOES
  I watch → he WATCHES
  I play → he PLAYS

QARAMA-QARSHI fikrlarni 'but' bilan bog'lang:
  Tony goes to the swimming-pool twice a week,
  BUT he never goes to the theatre.

Kitobdagi boshlanish:
  'Tony goes to the swimming-pool twice a week, but he
   never goes to the theatre. ...'

example.speaker: namuna
example.en: Tony goes to the swimming-pool twice a week, but he never goes to the theatre.
example.uz: Toni haftada ikki marta basseynga boradi, lekin teatrga hech qachon bormaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Number the months in the correct order. Now listen and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Oylarni to'g'ri tartibda raqamlang. So'ng tinglab, takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N IKKI OY — hammasi KATTA HARF bilan yoziladi!
Bu o'zbek tilida yo'q qoida, shuning uchun eng ko'p unutiladi:
  ✅ January   ❌ january

QISQARTMALAR (uch harf):
  Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun,
  Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec
  (May, Jun, Jul qisqarmasligi ham mumkin)

TALAFFUZ TUZOQLARI:
  February /ˈfebruəri/ — birinchi 'r' ko'pincha tushiriladi: 'FEB-yu-ri'
  Wednesday emas, lekin shunga o'xshash — March /mɑːtʃ/
  August /ˈɔːɡəst/ — 'OO-gest'

OY BILAN PREDLOG — IN:
  in January, in May, in December

items.whyUz: Kitobda berilgan. Yilning birinchi oyi. Rimliklarning Yanus xudosi nomidan.
Ikkinchi oy. Eng qisqa oy (28 yoki 29 kun).
Uchinchi oy. Mars xudosi nomidan. Bahor boshlanishi.
To'qqizinchi oy. Lotincha 'septem' = yetti (qadimgi kalendarda 7-oy edi).

rule.titleUz: AT / ON / IN — qaysi biri qachon
rule.explanationUz:
UCHTA PREDLOG, UCHTA QOIDA.
Ularni ANIQLIK darajasi bo'yicha eslash oson:

  AT — eng ANIQ nuqta (soat)
  ON — bir KUN
  IN — uzun DAVR (oy, fasl, yil)

  AT → ON → IN
  aniq  →  kun  →  uzoq davr

JADVAL (kitobdagi uchta ustun):

  AT                ON                  IN
  six o'clock       Friday(s)           May
  the weekend       Sunday morning(s)   spring/summer
  night             2 August            the morning/
  noon              6 May, 1978         evening/afternoon
                                        1998

DIQQAT — ISTISNOLAR:
  at NIGHT       (in the night EMAS)
  at the WEEKEND (Britaniyada; AQShda 'on the weekend')
  at NOON        (tush payti)
  IN the morning/evening/afternoon — LEKIN
  ON Sunday morning — aniq kun aytilsa ON!

table.subject: AT
table.full: six o'clock, the weekend, night, noon

keyRules.uzRule: AT — soat bilan va 'the weekend', 'night', 'noon' so'zlari bilan.
keyRules.enRule: We use at with the time and with the weekend, night and noon.

keyRules.uzRule: ON — hafta kunlari, aniq kunning qismlari va sanalar bilan.
keyRules.enRule: We use on with days of the week, the parts of a particular day and dates.

keyRules.uzRule: IN — oylar, fasllar, yillar va 'the morning/evening/afternoon' bilan.
keyRules.enRule: We use in with months, seasons, years and with the morning/evening/afternoon.

rule.warningUz:
ENG CHALKASH JOY — 'morning' bilan IN va ON:

  IN the morning        — umuman ertalab (har kuni)
  ON Sunday morning     — ANIQ kunning ertalabi
  ON Monday afternoons  — dushanba kunlari kunduzi

QOIDA: kun NOMI aytilsa → ON, aytilmasa → IN.

Va 'night' — ISTISNO:
  ✅ at night          ❌ in the night
  LEKIN: on Friday night (kun nomi bor → ON)
rule.noteUz:
PREDLOGSIZ ishlatiladigan vaqt so'zlari:
  every day / week / month / year
  this morning / week / year
  next Monday / week
  last night / week
  today, tomorrow, yesterday

  ✅ I go there every day.
  ❌ I go there in every day.
rule.extraUz:
SANA O'QILISHI (og'zaki):
  2 August    → the second of August
              → August the second (AQShda)
  6 May 1978  → the sixth of May, nineteen seventy-eight

YIL O'QILISHI:
  1978 → nineteen seventy-eight
  1998 → nineteen ninety-eight
  2005 → two thousand and five
  2024 → twenty twenty-four

exercises.instructionEn: Study the rules, then fill in on, in and at.
exercises.instructionUz: Qoidalarni o'rganing, so'ng on, in va at ni jadvalga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
Kitobdagi jadvalning UCHTA SARLAVHASI bo'sh.
Har bir ustundagi so'zlarga qarab predlogni toping.

items.textEn: 1-ustun: six o'clock, the weekend, night, noon → ____
items.whyUz: Qoida: 'We use AT with the time and with the weekend, night and noon.'

items.uz: Hafta kunlari va sanalar bilan qaysi predlog?
items.whyUz: Qoida: 'We use ON with days of the week, the parts of a particular day and dates.'

items.uz: Oy, fasl, yil bilan qaysi predlog?
items.whyUz: Qoida: 'We use IN with months, seasons, years and with the morning/evening/afternoon.'

exercises.instructionEn: More practice: at, on or in?
exercises.instructionUz: Qo'shimcha mashq: at, on yoki in?
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir iborada NIMA turganiga qarang:
  soat / weekend / night / noon → AT
  kun nomi / sana                → ON
  oy / fasl / yil / kun qismi    → IN

items.whyUz: ISTISNO: at night ('in the night' EMAS).
Britaniyada AT the weekend. AQShda 'on the weekend'.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the table, then listen and fill in the missing information. Next, make sentences, as in the example. Finally, write about yourself.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni o'rganing, so'ng tinglab, tushib qolgan ma'lumotni yozing. Namunadagidek gap tuzing. Oxirida o'zingiz haqingizda yozing.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kassetada Meri va Royning tug'ilgan yili, vaqti va kun qismi aytiladi. Audio yo'q — quyida FAQAT jadvalda BERILGAN ma'lumot bilan gap tuziladi, noma'lum qismlar '...' bilan ko'rsatilgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL:
         DATE          MONTH   YEAR   TIME    PART OF DAY
  Tom    Friday 22nd   March   1957   10:30   night
  Mary   Monday 6th    July    ?      2:00    ?
  Roy    ? 3rd         August  1955   ?       afternoon
  You    (o'zingiz)

NAMUNA GAP (kitobda berilgan):
  Tom was born ON Friday the 22nd of March, IN 1957,
  AT half past ten AT night.

QOLIP — TO'RTTA PREDLOG bir gapda:
  was born ON + kun va sana
           IN + yil
           AT + soat
           AT night / IN the morning / IN the afternoon

SANA O'QILISHI:
  Friday 22nd March → Friday the twenty-second of March
  ('the' va 'of' qo'shiladi!)

TARTIB SONLAR:
  1st first, 2nd second, 3rd third, 4th fourth,
  6th sixth, 22nd twenty-second, 3rd third

example.speaker: namuna
example.en: Tom was born on Friday the 22nd of March, in 1957, at half past ten at night.
example.uz: Tom 1957-yil 22-mart, juma kuni kechasi soat o'n yarimda tug'ilgan.

modelSentences.uz: Meri 6-iyul, dushanba kuni soat ikkida tug'ilgan.
modelSentences.note: Yil va kun qismi audio orqali beriladi.

modelSentences.sentence: Roy was born on the 3rd of August, in 1955, in the afternoon.
modelSentences.note: Hafta kuni va aniq vaqt audio orqali beriladi.

modelSentences.sentence: I was born on Tuesday the 15th of April, in 2010, at six o'clock in the morning.
modelSentences.uz: Men 2010-yil 15-aprel, seshanba kuni ertalab soat oltida tug'ilganman.

exercises.explanationUz:
SANA O'QILISHIDA 'the' va 'of' QO'SHILADI:

  Yozilishi: 22 March
  O'qilishi: the twenty-second OF March

  Yozilishi: Friday 22nd March 1957
  O'qilishi: Friday THE twenty-second OF March, nineteen fifty-seven

TARTIB SONLAR QOIDASI:
  1 → first (1st)      2 → second (2nd)    3 → third (3rd)
  4 → fourth (4th)     5 → fifth (5th)     6 → sixth (6th)
  ...
  20 → twentieth (20th)
  21 → twenty-first    22 → twenty-second  23 → twenty-third
  30 → thirtieth (30th) 31 → thirty-first

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in at, in or on then talk about Henry's daily routine and free-time activities.
exercises.instructionUz: at, in yoki on ni qo'ying, so'ng Genrining kundalik tartibi va bo'sh vaqti haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
GENRI JONS — 50 yoshli DEHQON (farmer).
Uning kuni Bob Ellisnikidan ham ertaroq boshlanadi!

Har bir bo'shliqda vaqt ifodasi turibdi:
  soat            → AT
  kun qismi       → IN the ...
  kun nomi        → ON
  aniq kun qismi  → ON (kun nomi bilan)

DIQQAT — 8 va 9-bo'shliqlar GAP BOSHIDA:
  katta harf bilan yoziladi (On Saturday..., On Sundays...)

lines.textEn: Henry Jones, 50, is a farmer. "It's a tiring job," he says, "but I like it a lot."
lines.uz: Genri Jons, 50 yoshda, dehqon. 'Bu charchatadigan ish', — deydi u, — 'lekin men uni juda yoqtiraman.'

lines.textEn: Every day, Henry wakes up 1) ____ half past four ...
... 2) ____ the morning and milks the cows.
lines.hintUz: 'the morning' — kun qismi, kun nomi yo'q
lines.whyUz: Kun qismi (kun nomisiz) → IN the morning. 'milk' fe'l sifatida — sut sog'moq.

lines.textEn: He finishes 3) ____ about half past six.
After that, he goes back to the farmhouse and has breakfast, then he feeds the animals.
lines.uz: Shundan keyin u ferma uyiga qaytadi va nonushta qiladi, so'ng hayvonlarni boqadi.

lines.whyUz: ISTISNO: at noon (tush payti). Qoidada aynan sanalgan.

lines.textEn: 5) ____ two o'clock, he goes to the fields and works there until five.
lines.whyUz: Soat → AT. Gap boshida katta harf. 'a field' = dala.

lines.textEn: 6) ____ the evening, he milks the cows again, then he goes back home and has a shower.
lines.whyUz: Kun qismi → IN the evening. Gap boshida katta harf.

lines.textEn: He sometimes watches TV before he goes to bed 7) ____ about nine.
8) ____ Saturday afternoons, he goes to the local playing-field to watch the village team play football.
lines.whyUz: Kun nomi bo'lsa ON ('in the afternoon' EMAS!). Gap boshida katta harf.
Hafta kuni → ON. 'On Sundays' = har yakshanba. Gap boshida katta harf.

lines.textEn: "I like the way I live," says Henry. "Working in the open air makes me feel good."
lines.uz: 'Yashash tarzimni yoqtiraman', — deydi Genri. — 'Ochiq havoda ishlash o'zimni yaxshi his qildiradi.'

exercises.instructionEn: Then talk about Henry's daily routine and free-time activities.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng Genrining kundalik tartibi va bo'sh vaqti haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
Matnni qayta aytib bering. Vaqt predloglarini to'g'ri ishlating.

UCH QISMGA BO'LING:
  1) ertalab
  2) kunduzi va kechqurun
  3) bo'sh vaqti (shanba va yakshanba)

structure.modelEn: Henry Jones is fifty years old and he is a farmer.
He says it is a tiring job, but he likes it a lot.
Every day, Henry wakes up at half past four in the morning and milks the cows.
He finishes at about half past six, then he goes back to the farmhouse and has breakfast.
After breakfast, he feeds the animals.
He has lunch at noon. At two o'clock, he goes to the fields and works there until five.
In the evening, he milks the cows again, then he goes back home and has a shower.
He sometimes watches TV before he goes to bed at about nine.
On Saturday afternoons, he goes to the local playing-field to watch the village team play football.
He likes the way he lives because working in the open air makes him feel good.
structure.noteUz: 'I' → 'he' ga o'zgaradi: makes ME feel → makes HIM feel.

wordFormation.introUz: 38-bet — oylar, tartib sonlar va vaqt predloglari.

groups.ruleUz: Oy nomlari — hammasi KATTA harf bilan
groups.explanationUz: Ko'pchiligi rim xudolari va imperatorlari nomidan. Oxirgi to'rttasi lotincha sonlardan.
Sanalar TARTIB SON bilan aytiladi. Birinchi uchtasi noto'g'ri shakl.
1 va 2 uchun maxsus so'zlar bor, 3 dan boshlab 'times'.

patterns.formula: How often do you + fe'l? — Once/Twice a week. / Never. / Every day.
patterns.exampleEn: How often do you go to the swimming-pool? — Twice a week.
patterns.exampleUz: Basseynga qanchalik tez-tez borasiz? — Haftada ikki marta.
patterns.explanationUz: 'How often' — takrorlanishni so'raydi. Javob to'liq gap bo'lishi shart emas.

patterns.formula: somebody + fe'l+S + takrorlanish, BUT he/she NEVER + fe'l+S + ...
patterns.exampleEn: Tony goes to the swimming-pool twice a week, but he never goes to the theatre.
patterns.exampleUz: Toni haftada ikki marta basseynga boradi, lekin teatrga hech qachon bormaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: Ijobiy va salbiy odatni 'but' bilan qarama-qarshi qo'yish.

patterns.formula: somebody was born ON + kun/sana, IN + yil, AT + soat, AT night / IN the morning.
patterns.exampleEn: Tom was born on Friday the 22nd of March, in 1957, at half past ten at night.
patterns.exampleUz: Tom 1957-yil 22-mart, juma kuni kechasi o'n yarimda tug'ilgan.
patterns.explanationUz:
To'rtta predlog bir gapda — har biri o'z qoidasi bo'yicha.
Sana o'qilishida 'the' va 'of' qo'shiladi.

patterns.formula: AT + soat, IN + kun qismi, ON + kun nomi.
patterns.exampleEn: He wakes up at half past four in the morning. On Sundays, Henry relaxes.
patterns.exampleUz: U ertalab to'rt yarimda uyg'onadi. Yakshanba kunlari Genri dam oladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Kun NOMI bo'lsa ON, bo'lmasa IN:
  in the afternoon ↔ ON Saturday afternoons

patterns.formula: somebody goes to + joy + TO + fe'l (maqsad).
patterns.exampleEn: He goes to the local playing-field to watch the village team play football.
patterns.exampleUz: U qishloq jamoasining futbolini tomosha qilish uchun mahalliy sport maydoniga boradi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ikkinchi 'to' MAQSADNI bildiradi ('...ish uchun').
'watch somebody DO something' — 'to' KERAK EMAS: watch the team PLAY.

patterns.exampleEn: Working in the open air makes me feel good.
patterns.exampleUz: Ochiq havoda ishlash o'zimni yaxshi his qildiradi.
patterns.explanationUz:
-ing shakli gap EGASI bo'la oladi.
'make somebody FEEL' — 'to' KERAK EMAS.
